import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
df['촉매로트군'] = df['촉매로트'].apply(lambda x: 'old' if x in ['FC-2602', 'FC-2603', 'FC-2604', 'FC-2605'] else 'new')
df['bin'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25), right=False)
counts = df.groupby(['촉매로트군', 'bin']).size().rename('n').reset_index()
df = df.merge(counts, on=['촉매로트군', 'bin'])
df = df[df['n'] >= 10]
